synthesizedFacts.fact: Tretinoin can cause skin dryness, redness, and flakiness during the initial adjustment period.
Moisturizer can be applied before, after, or both before and after tretinoin to help manage irritation.
Using a moisturizer does not weaken the effectiveness of tretinoin.
The 'sandwich method' involves applying moisturizer before and after tretinoin to lock in hydration.
